answer: By the nectar of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, capped per identity per epoch, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Every claim climbs the marble of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the prism re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
